metric: master output RMS over 1.8s of playback, dBFS, sampled post-limiter
_comment: Live-path loudness baseline (goal item 6), measured on v1.16.17 BEFORE any per-genre mix or loudness trim existed. Producer: scripts/measure_live_loudness.mjs, which taps the app's realtime engine at AudioContext.destination over 1.8s of playback (post-limiter) in a real Chromium (local dist, ephemeral port). Deliberately a different measurement path from the offline per-genre report produced by the mix workstream. Repeatability of this harness across three full runs: spread (max-min) 5.17 / 5.16 dB and p90-p10 3.92 / 3.68 dB, compare delta 1.11 / 1.11 dB -- the aggregate spread is stable to ~0.1 dB. INDIVIDUAL genre readings are noisier: boom-bap measured -16.4 / -17.0 / -17.3 dB across runs, because the fixed 1.8s sampling window lands on different bars of the loop and pattern density varies within a genre. Judge acceptance on the SPREAD, not on single-genre deltas.

repeatability.note: aggregate spread stable ~0.1 dB; individual genres vary up to ~0.9 dB (sampling window lands on different bars)
